input.title: Women's Christmas – French Bulldog Silent Night, Except the Snoring Crewneck Sweatshirt
input.descriptionHtml:
The Story

Silent night, except the snoring: a Frenchie sweatshirt for the dog mom who is up first on Christmas morning with a coffee, a cold floor and a bulldog that will not leave the tree skirt. Wear it by the tree, at the cookie swap or on the cold walk with the dog.

Under the words, a fawn French Bulldog with a dark mask and big upright bat ears wears a crooked red Santa hat and lies belly-down on a plaid tree skirt between two wrapped presents, eyes shut, mouth open, a few z's drifting up. Pine needles and a fallen red ornament sit nearby. SILENT NIGHT. runs across the top and EXCEPT THE SNORING. across the bottom, in deep red and pine green on Sand and in cream and mustard on Navy.

The 1950s Christmas-card art makes an easy gift from a partner, a sister or the dog walker. Original art, made for Graphic Tees Co. and printed the day you order it.

Details & Fit

  • Classic unisex crewneck sweatshirt fit
  • 50% cotton, 50% polyester fleece
  • Fabric weight: 8 oz/yd²
  • Ribbed crew neck, cuffs and waistband; no hood, no pockets
  • Sizes S–3XL
  • 2 colors: Sand, Navy

Questions

How does the Silent Night, Except the Snoring crewneck fit?
This classic unisex Gildan 18000 crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. comes in sizes S through 3XL. Order your usual size for a regular fit, or size down one for a closer look; go up one for a roomy layer over a long-sleeve tee. If the size is off, we offer one free size exchange within 30 days.

How warm is it and what is it made of?
The Silent Night, Except the Snoring crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. is 50% cotton and 50% polyester fleece at 8 oz per square yard, with a ribbed collar, cuffs and waistband and no hood. It is a mid-weight, cozy layer for a cold tree-side morning. Machine wash cold inside out and tumble dry low.

What colors does it come in and how is it printed?
It comes in Sand and Navy, both in sizes S through 3XL. On Sand the headline is deep red and the punch line pine green; on Navy they turn cream and mustard, with a cream outline around the dog so the linework stays clear. Graphic Tees Co. prints each one to order.

Who is this a good gift for?
It suits the Frenchie mom, a partner who has heard the snoring from the next room, or a sister whose dog owns the couch. Graphic Tees Co. prints it to order, orders of $45 or more ship free, and the free size exchange within 30 days covers a wrong guess on size.

When should I order it for Christmas?
Order by about December 8 so the Silent Night, Except the Snoring crewneck from Graphic Tees Co. arrives before Christmas. Each sweatshirt is printed to order, which takes a few business days, then ships within the US. A misprint or damaged item is reprinted or refunded within 30 days.
